Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 19-Jun-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FOURTH SEMESTER B.TECH. (INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY) DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - JUNE 2024  
  SUBJECT: MAT 2226/MAT_2226 - ENGINEERING MATHEMATICS - IV  
  ENGINEERING MATHEMATICS - IV [MAT 2226]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                        Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
Missing data may be suitably assumed.  
  
1A)                Six people toss a fair coin one after the other until a player obtains a head. The game is won by the (4)  
  player who throws head first. Find the probability of success of the 4 th player.  
  
1B)                Two defective tubes get mixed up with 6 good ones. The tubes are tested one by one, until both           (3)  
  defective tubes are found. What is the probability that the last defective tube is obtained on (a) the  
  2nd test, (b) the 3rd test.  
  
1C)                Let X be a discrete random variable having the probability mass function given by:                       (3)  
  x                1          2             3              4              5  
  $$P(X = x)             1/15       2/15          3/15           4/15           5/15$$  
  
  (i) Check whether the given function is a valid probability mass function.  
  (ii) Calculate P(1/2 < X < 5/2 | X > 1).  
2A)                Find the mean and variance of a random variable X which is uniformly distributed in the interval (-a, (4)  
  a).  
2B)                An aircraft knows that 5% of the people making reservation on a certain flight will not show up.         (3)  
  Consequently, their policy is to sell 52 tickets for the flight that can only hold 50 passengers. What  
  is the probability that there will be a seat available for every passenger who turns up?  
2C)                                                                                                                          (3)  
  
  
3A)                Let (X, Y) have the joint pdf                                                                            (4)  
  
  
  (i) Find the mean and variance of X and Y.  
  (ii) Find E(X | Y).  
3B)                Urn A contains 5 black balls, 6 white balls. Urn B contains 8 black balls and 4 white balls. Two balls (3)  
  are transferred from B to A and then a ball is drawn from A.  
  i) What is the probability that this ball is white?  
  ii) Given that the ball is drawn is white. what is the probability that one black ball was transferred to  
  A?  
3C)                The survival time X (in terms of weeks) of a male mouse exposed to radiation has Gamma                   (3)  
  distribution with PDF  
  Page 1 of 2

Find the probability that a mouse survives:  
  i) Between 60 and 120 weeks  
  ii) At least 30 weeks  
4A)                                                                                                          (4)  
  
  
  i) Find joint probability distribution of X and Y.  
  $$ii) Find probability distribution of Z = X + Y.$$  
4B)   The probability that a news reader commits no mistakes in reading the news during one broadcast        (3)  
  is   . Find the probability that in ten news broadcasts he commits  
  
  i) Only one mistake  
  ii) More than 3 mistakes  
  iii) At most 2 mistakes.  
4C)   Assume that the average life span of computers produced by the company is 2040 hours with              (3)  
  standard deviation 60 hours. Find the expected number of computers, whose life span is:  
  i) more than 2150 hours,  
  ii) less than 1950 hours,  
  iii) between 1920 and 2160 hours  
  from a pool of 2000 computers, assuming that life span, X, is normally distributed.  
5A)   According to the ideal grading curve, the percentages of students receiving grades A+, A, B, C, D,     (4)  
  E, and F should be, respectively, 0.1, 2.2, 13.6, 34.1, 34.1, 13.6, and 2.3. In an exam with 2000  
  students, the numbers of students getting grades A+, A, B, C, D, E, and F are, respectively, 3, 48,  
  290, 642, 724, 280, 13. Test whether the grade distribution fits the ideal grading curve, using Chi-  
  square test at 5% significance level.

5C)   The mean life length of a certain cutting tool is 41.5 hours with a standard deviation of 2.5 hours.   (3)  
  What is the probability that a random sample of size 50 drawn from this population will have a  
  sample mean between 40.5 and 42 hours.
